digest.component_or_area: LLM framework structured output and cache instrumentation
propositions: Direct Anthropic live structured cache canary must run two identical-prefix calls (write then read) through PydanticAIRunner and record usage counts including cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, input_tokens, and requests without exposing credentials
Bedrock live structured cache canary must run the same two-call sequence over bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 through ambient AWS credentials and record identical usage metrics

Observed accounting from both canary arms must match the documented contract in docs/llm-framework.md section 'The structured retry layers and their accounting (one bounded operation)' count-by-count, including single request per call, omit-branch behavior, and cache read/write/input token relationship

Complete-or-omit projection branch must be directly instrumented via the seam-1 wire-projection capability to record messages_in, messages_kept, failed_output_candidates, and omitted decision on each before_model_request invocation
